title: Jachin, Boaz & the Paired Threshold — Temple, Pillars, Guardians and Geometry
purpose: Place Jachin and Boaz correctly inside the project's Temple/Door/paired-guardian architecture, and use elementary geometry to extract a general pair→midpoint→axis→passage structure without claiming all paired symbols are historically identical.
epistemic_rule: Jachin and Boaz are biblical Temple pillars. Their later Jewish, Christian, Masonic and esoteric reception histories are distinct layers. The compass/ruler model below is a modern mathematical comparator, not evidence that Solomon's builders encoded the Potatoverse or that the pillars secretly are the project's guardians.

facts: Two named bronze pillars stand at the Temple porch/vestibule.
The pillars are named Jachin and Boaz.
Translations and reconstructions describe them as flanking the entrance, with right/left and south/north descriptions depending on textual/viewpoint convention.

name_glosses.Jachin: commonly glossed along the lines of 'He establishes' / 'He will establish'
name_glosses.Boaz: commonly glossed along the lines of 'In him is strength' / 'by strength'

biblical_base.function_caution: Their exact architectural/ritual function is debated. They should not automatically be treated as load-bearing columns or reduced to later esoteric meanings.

paired_threshold_model.points: Represent the two pillars by points J and B in a plane.
paired_threshold_model.frame_axis: line JB describes the left-right/flanking relation.
paired_threshold_model.passage_axis: The perpendicular bisector through M supplies the natural approach/departure line if the two pillars symmetrically frame an entrance.
paired_threshold_model.result: Two flankers generate a center and a perpendicular axis, but neither flanker is itself the center or the Door.

compass_construction.method: With J and B as endpoints, equal-radius arcs centered at J and B construct their perpendicular bisector. The intersection of that bisector with JB gives midpoint M.
compass_construction.project_epiphany: A paired threshold can generate its own central axis geometrically. The center is relational: it is determined by the pair rather than supplied as a third arbitrary point.
compass_construction.relation_to_vesica: If equal circles are drawn from J and B with radius JB, their overlap is a vesica; its two circle-intersection points lie on the perpendicular bisector and create a lens centered on M.
compass_construction.caution: This is an optional geometric construction from the pair. The biblical texts do not state that Jachin and Boaz were laid out as a vesica construction.

april_9_reverse_parallel.earlier_structure: On 2026-04-09 recovered project language had one guardian on the right and one on the left, a narrow gate to Heaven between them, Jesus associated with the path/passage, and Father above.
april_9_reverse_parallel.later_jachin_boaz: Jachin and Boaz are explicitly present in Tim's 2026-09-05 Temple/vesica synthesis.
april_9_reverse_parallel.source_direction: The April paired-guardian architecture predates the September Jachin/Boaz naming. Therefore Jachin/Boaz may be used as a later biblical/architectural comparator for an earlier project pattern, but must not be backdated into April or treated as proof that the April guardians 'were' Jachin and Boaz.
april_9_reverse_parallel.structural_overlap: paired flankers → central access → sacred/House destination

september_5_attestation.importance: Because Jachin and Boaz were user-originated project vocabulary by this date, this atlas expands an existing Timic Temple-pillar node rather than importing a wholly new motif.

right_left_viewpoint_problem.issue: Right and left depend on which direction an observer faces. Temple descriptions may also be converted into compass directions by reconstruction/translation.
right_left_viewpoint_problem.rule: Store absolute orientation (north/south/east/west) separately from observer-relative left/right whenever a source permits it.
right_left_viewpoint_problem.project_value: This is especially important for Red/Blue, guardian, pillar, Father/Son and other bilateral diagrams. A left/right symbolic assignment should never be treated as invariant until the viewpoint is specified.

establishment_strength_semantics.historical_layer: The pillar names carry establishment/strength semantics in common interpretation.
establishment_strength_semantics.project_layer: A cautious project reading can treat the pair as stability conditions flanking passage: establishment without strength may be fragile; strength without establishment may be force without durable order.
establishment_strength_semantics.door_relation: The Door is not either property alone. Passage occurs between/through a boundary stabilized by its flanks.
establishment_strength_semantics.boundary: This synthesis is project philosophy, not an assertion that 1 Kings teaches a mathematical theory of complementary variables.

temple_house_city_extension.temple: The pillars belong to a porch/entrance context before deeper sanctuary space.
temple_house_city_extension.holy_of_holies: The repository separately tracks the 20×20×20 cubit inner sanctuary of 1 Kings 6:20 as cube-like sacred space.
temple_house_city_extension.new_jerusalem: The repository separately tracks Revelation 21-22's measured city and gates as an expanded sacred-city architecture.
temple_house_city_extension.project_sequence: flanking pillars → threshold/porch → House/sanctuary → city/open-gate architecture
temple_house_city_extension.insight: This helps keep the project from collapsing every architectural object into the same symbol: Pillar supports/marks; Door transitions; House contains; City networks many Houses/Doors; Axis orients the total structure.

reception_history_rule.freemasonry: Jachin and Boaz became important in later Masonic symbolism and iconography. That later reception can be studied as a separate historical layer.
reception_history_rule.do_not_infer: Later Masonic use does not establish that every compass-and-square, pillar, vesica, 33, Temple, or Potatoverse motif descends from one ancient encoded system.
reception_history_rule.research_method: For each claimed overlap record date, source tradition, earliest attestation, function, geometric similarity, and whether the connection is historical, symbolic, structural, or newly synthesized.

new_project_edges: September Jachin/Boaz → later comparator for April paired guardians
